def minimumSum(S):
    n = len(S)
    left = 0
    right = n - 1
    total_diff = 0
    
    while left < right:
        if S[left] != '?' and S[right] != '?' and S[left] != S[right]:
            return -1
        
        if S[left] == '?' and S[right] == '?':
            # Replace both '?' with the same character to minimize ASCII difference
            S = S[:left] + 'a' + S[left+1:right] + 'a' + S[right+1:]
            total_diff += 0
        elif S[left] == '?':
            # Replace '?' with the character at the right position
            S = S[:left] + S[right] + S[left+1:right]
            total_diff += abs(ord(S[left]) - ord(S[left+1]))
        elif S[right] == '?':
            # Replace '?' with the character at the left position
            S = S[:right] + S[left] + S[right+1:]
            total_diff += abs(ord(S[right]) - ord(S[right-1]))
        
        left += 1
        right -= 1
    
    return total_diff
